slice: INT-RH2 - Raising Home Phase 2 Presentation Integration
purpose: The only surface Codex binds presentation to. Codex reads frames and raises intents; it never reads Claude internal state and never holds gameplay truth. Everything here is read-only except the named intents.

rendererSplit.dom: application and screen UI - Codex, P1R system
rendererSplit.pixi: Raising playable field, actors, props, 2D presentation - Claude owns the runtime integration, Codex owns visual QA

api.getFrame(): returns a RaisingPresentationFrame; pure read, never mutates
api.subscribe(listener): listener(frame) on every runtime change; returns an unsubscribe function

producer.note: Codex must not import championshipStandaloneApp, championshipRaisingProduction, any R2 module, or any catalog. This factory is the whole seam.

frame.revision: integer, increments on every runtime change; use it to skip redundant repaints

cages.name: product-authored display name
cages.note: Product-authored habitat prototypes. NOT the original 36-CageDefinition catalogue. Presentation must not imply otherwise.

residents.cageId: the cage this creature currently belongs to

save.phase: DIRTY | SAVED | RESTORED | RECOVERED | CLEAN | SAVE_FAILED

affordances.note: Pointer Events only. Mouse and touch use one code path; there is no keyboard-navigation model and no directional input.

slots.buttonNode: buttonN - slot N is buttonN, left to right

submenuEntries.note: Storage is proven; population is not. Always empty in this contract version.

toolbar.presentationRule: Render all eight slots as the ROM-verified shell, in ROM order, at the ROM geometry. Every slot is a neutral, disabled placeholder carrying its raw slot id. Do not label, icon, or activate any slot. Do not hide slots to make the row look finished.

implementedActions.note: The only actions with real runtime behaviour today. They are deliberately NOT mapped to toolbar slots: that mapping is UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE and inventing it is the exact error this programme exists to prevent. Surface them as their own affordances until evidence closes the binding.

actions.trigger: drag a creature onto another cage
actions.effect: cage assignment changes; no other effect is applied because none is verified
actions.evidence: ROM_VERIFIED interaction grammar (hand icon grabs and drops); consequences UNKNOWN

actions.trigger: invoke the care intent on a selected creature
actions.effect: one-shot reaction animation plus a product-authored interaction flag; mutates no gameplay stat
actions.evidence: ROM_VERIFIED that a care tool exists and is used by touching the creature; exact values UNKNOWN

intents.note: The only mutation entry points. Codex calls these; Codex never writes state.
intents.relocateCreature(creatureId, cageId): commit a drop; a no-op if the creature already belongs to that cage
intents.careForCreature(creatureId): run the care interaction; returns the updated frame
intents.requestSave(): persist; returns the updated save block

excludedFromPresentation.note: Deliberately absent. Requesting any of these is a contract violation, not a missing feature.
fields: satiety, energy, ease, readiness - R2 adaptation stats, removed from the player-facing HUD by Owner ruling
caretakerPosition - R2 prototype only; no player avatar exists
the R2 24x14 grid and tile coordinates
eventLog and raw domain feedback strings - product copy is adapted before it reaches a frame
any forensic catalog record, evidence claim, or promotion manifest field
any original ROM pixel or ROM-derived binary asset path

statusModelNote.romVerified: HP, Capacity, Attack, Defense, Intelligence, Speed, Family, Generation, Attribute, Personality
statusModelNote.state: No values exist for any of them in this build. The frame exposes none, and presentation must not show placeholder numbers. Product-authored initial values may be defined later under explicit product authority.

saveLoadProof.requirement: initial state -> resident interaction -> save -> reload -> restored state
saveLoadProof.purpose: Proves the UI and Pixi presentation hold no second copy of gameplay truth.
saveLoadProof.currentRuntimeEvidence: Already proven at the runtime layer: cage assignment and the interaction flag survive a real page reload. INT-RH2 must show it survives with the P1R UI and Pixi field in place.

implementation.note: The Pixi module is field-scoped and consumes only this contract source. The eight neutral toolbar shells remain DOM screen UI under the Owner renderer policy.
